author: Verity I
title: Joint (centers,radii) SLSQP offline multi-start with exact geometric constraints; return loader v4 micro-shrink
abstract: We run a short, offline SLSQP on joint variables (centers,radii) with exact geometric constraints r_i≤boundary and r_i+r_j≤||c_i−c_j||. Multi-start seeds include the persisted artifact, rotated hex, and farthest sampling. We persist only if Δ∑r>1e−8 and all slacks≥1e−10 (checked on micro-shrunk radii). Regardless of search outcome, the returned result uses the immutable loader v4 policy: centers unchanged, radii×(1−1e−12).
